application_sentences: PagesView full catalog MTS Bionix® Tabletop Test Systems Product catalog summary Overview: MTS Bionix® Tabletop Test Systems are compact servohydraulic systems designed for biomedical testing, focusing on biomaterials and medical components to ensure compliance with industry standards.
Key Features: Axial Configuration: Suitable for various tests including fatigue life and fracture growth, supporting up to ±25 kN and displacements of ±50 mm.
Axial/Torsional Configuration: Allows biaxial testing with torsional moments up to ±250 N·m and rotations of 270°, ideal for implant testing.
Applications: Biomaterial Characterization: Tests for yield strength, fatigue, and wear characteristics.
